module_summary: Virtual-FIFO encoder: splits AXI-Stream beats into segments stored in per-lane segment RAMs, tracks block length/meta in a header FIFO, then emits segmented output words with inserted block headers, padding on timeout.

anchors.name: seg_ram[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-lane segment RAM buffering packed input data segments.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_len
anchors.why: Header FIFO RAM storing block lengths (with last/meta arrays).

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload split into segments.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with tready writes segments and advances write pointer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from input/header FIFO full flags and fifo reset.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output word with headers and data to virtual FIFO channel.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid bits; also reset block timeout.

anchors.name: out_frame_reg
anchors.why: Output controller state: idle/header vs streaming a block's segments.

anchors.name: fifo_watermark_in
anchors.why: Downstream watermark backpressure stalling header processing and output generation.

anchors.name: input_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO write pointer advanced by segment count per accepted beat.

anchors.name: input_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO read pointer selecting segment RAM reads.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Write-side block state: starting new header vs accumulating block length.

anchors.name: out_seg_offset_reg
anchors.why: Output segment lane offset rotating headers/enables across output segments.

anchors.name: out_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Block header word (len, last, meta, parity) inserted into output segment.

anchors.name: block_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Partial-block timeout counter triggering padding insertion.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer advanced on header commit.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer advanced when header consumed.

anchors.name: input_fifo_full_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO near-full flag deasserting s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_full_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO near-full flag deasserting s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: hdr_fifo_empty_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO empty; gates header reads.

anchors.name: input_fifo_count_reg
anchors.why: Segment FIFO occupancy limiting how many segments are read.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_sel
anchors.why: Selects which input segment feeds each segment RAM lane.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_data
anchors.why: Rotated segment data written into segment RAM lanes.

anchors.name: seg_mem_wr_en
anchors.why: Per-lane segment RAM write enables on accepted beat.

anchors.name: len_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated block byte length for header, limited by MAX_BLOCK_LEN.

anchors.name: cycle_valid_reg
anchors.why: Registered beat-accepted flag enabling header length processing.

anchors.name: cycle_meta_reg
anchors.why: Registered beat metadata; change forces new block header.

anchors.name: cycle_last_reg
anchors.why: Registered tlast ending current block.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Header write enable into header FIFO memory.

anchors.name: hdr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Commits header entry, advancing header write pointer.

anchors.name: hdr_mem_rd_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Header read data available; starts new output block.

anchors.name: mem_rd_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Per-lane segment read data valid tracking for reads.

anchors.name: out_seg_cnt_in_reg
anchors.why: Remaining segments in current output block.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_en_reg
anchors.why: Per-output-segment enable driving output_valid and read release.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Selects header insertion into an output segment.

anchors.name: out_ctl_seg_idx_reg
anchors.why: Maps output segment to segment RAM lane read data.

anchors.name: out_shift_reg
anchors.why: Carries segment tail bytes shifted by header width into next segment.

anchors.name: block_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout expired; inserts padding to flush partial block.

anchors.name: fifo_rst_in
anchors.why: Flush request clearing pointers/state and blocking input.

groups.name: Segment FIFO
groups.description: Per-lane segment RAMs with write/read pointers, count and full flags.

groups.name: Segment packer
groups.description: Splits input beat by tkeep into segments and rotates them onto RAM lanes.

groups.name: Header generator
groups.description: Accumulates block length/meta per frame and commits headers to header FIFO.

groups.name: Header FIFO
groups.description: Header len/last/meta memory with pointers and flags.

groups.name: Output controller
groups.description: Reads headers, sequences block segments, rotates lane offsets, handles timeout padding.

groups.name: Output assembly
groups.description: Muxes headers and shifted segment RAM data into output segments with valids.

groups.name: Stream input
groups.description: AXI-Stream input handshake and virtual FIFO flow-control inputs.
